## FireRed API

FireRed is an image editing model by FireRed, available on the Venice API as `firered-image-edit`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

### FireRed API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `firered-image-edit` | Edit | Private | $0.04 / edit |

### FireRed specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | FireRed |
| Released | Mar 25, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| License | Apache 2.0 |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 9:16, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5 |
| Prompt limit | 1,500 characters |

### How to use the FireRed API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/edit` with `"model": "firered-image-edit"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/edit \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "firered-image-edit",
    "image": "<base64-encoded image>",
    "prompt": "Make it a rainy night scene"
  }' --output result.png
```
